adoptionSource: The project owner adopted revision 1 (7bce50fc) and subsequently specified OpenCode 2.x APIs exclusively, released A2UI 1.0, and the latest compatible stable AG-UI. The signed superseding binding identifies when this proposal is authorized for implementation.
amendmentPolicy: Any later change to scope, evidence, fixture identity, limits or scenario uses an explicit owner-approved superseding decision. Preserve the consumed budget and original receipts.

cleanup: Use trap/finally to stop suite children and restore files even if an earlier command fails.
Dispose of scratch credentials and owned client entries, preserve only redacted output. Reconcile any indeterminate effect before retrying.
expectedEffects: Build the actual native and image distributions with clean/default and optional memory configuration; capture zero-warning Cargo baseline, clippy, unit and plugin typecheck results separately.
Start only isolated native workers and disposable service/client profiles, exercise each positive and negative subcase with real collaborators, then restore resources.

Run checks through the installed package. Reading files or mocked success does not prove real login, subscription billing, native cancellation, editor registration, browser rendering, or deployed outcomes.
receipts: Per-run private manifest including exact executable/versions and subcase digests
Local redacted per-scenario evidence with independent expected/observed values, effects and controls
Restoration and cleanup record, failed/missing prerequisites, no account secrets
boundaryPacket.requiredApprovals: Separate owner authorization before live subscriber/paid operations or a machine-level change. Only disposable client profiles and an explicitly consented account may be used. Spec and contract adoption do not authorize running the boundary.
stopConditions: Any boundary without prerequisites, consent, identity or isolation is BLOCKED; a case not attempted is NOT_EXERCISED.
Unintended external charge/write, credential disclosure, or foreign account action stops subsequent affected work and requires reconciliation.
Exit zero alone is insufficient. Record each required subcase, a real failed oracle as FAIL, and any unresolved effects or exhausted budget.

budgets.exhaustion: Checkpoint and mark BLOCKED; preserve unresolved effects and receipts and request a budget amendment before further attempts.
budgets.tokenFallback: Time, tool-call, repair and no-progress ceilings bound the consolidated verification run; retain historical consumption.

digestNormalization.stalenessRule: Recompute normalized SHA-256 and compare with the latest non-superseded canonical decision, current spec-delta digest and calibration bytes.

evidenceInvalidation: Record contract, spec, relevant source, package, config, method and non-secret fixture hashes. Invalidate only affected scenario evidence on change. Retain earlier receipts with their original identities.
exclusions: Using a shared operator subscription for chat users or automatically falling back to separate paid API billing
Silent arbitrary function passthrough over the pinned Codex SDK
Public registry publication, changing personal workstation configurations during Spec, and automatic deployment

requiredSafetyChecks.description: Refresh, reload, recovery and native session resume preserve the authenticated owner, routing generation and authorized upstream with redacted credentials.
An unauthorized allowance cannot be charged and a tool effect cannot be duplicated, replayed or run outside an approved workspace.
Check direct API authorization and origin protection, owner-scoped files and memory, fail-closed concurrent writes, cleanup and redaction.
Plain text never creates executable UI. Invalid catalogs, frames, cross-user actions and duplicate activation cannot trigger privileged behavior.

deferredOptional: Additional unlisted ACP/MCP client adapters and unverified operating systems
A remote OpenCode SDK attach driver
Further A2UI wire versions or unregistered catalogs
resilienceScope.policy: Mandatory resilience includes logout/switch during refresh, unknown exchange outcome, partial store writes, mount replacement, session cancellation/replay, worker restart, tool duplication, foreign actions, stale configurations and degraded/unavailable features. These remain acceptance obligations if a prerequisite is missing or a budget is exhausted.
